newsitem.title: PERU: Peru 28-day CDs draw 14.79 pct avg rate at sale.
newsitem.headline: Peru 28-day CDs draw 14.79 pct avg rate at sale.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said Thursday it accepted bids for 28-day Certificates of Deposit (CDs) worth 20 million soles at an effective average annual rate of 14.79 percent during a bank auction BCQZ.
The CDs have an April 11 starting date.
The accepted bids also had a minimum rate of 14.49 percent and a maximum rate of 14.98 percent, the bank said.
The auction was the bank's first CD sale for almost three months due to a lack of liquidity in the financial sytem.
At the last CD auction January 15, 56-day CDs drew an average rate of 15.45 pct.
At Thursday's auction, the bank said it received bids on the CDs totalling 75.30 million soles.
The bank had offered 20 million soles worth of CDs.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
